title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch
tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

faults.what: The video is only 4.2 seconds long, rather than the explicitly requested 8 seconds.

judge.summary: The square talking portrait preserves the man's appearance and delivers a suitable sale invitation, but it is only 4.2 seconds instead of 8 seconds.

must_haves.item: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
must_haves.why: The frames preserve his recognizable facial features, grey hair, grey shirt, and kitchen setting.

must_haves.item: An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcript reads, "Our sale is here. Take a look and see what catches your eye," which is a coherent English invitation.

must_haves.item: The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
must_haves.why: The line mentions only the sale and invites viewers to look; it adds no specific offer details.

must_haves.item: The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
must_haves.why: The frames show different speaking mouth shapes, establishing visible mouth movement, but synchronization cannot be verified from still frames and an untimed transcript.

must_haves.item: The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.
must_haves.why: One square video is shown with no visible captions, but its stated duration is 4.2 seconds, not 8 seconds. The voice's gender and friendliness cannot be verified from the transcript alone.
